data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 29/1747Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO MAKES LANDFALL A LITTLE EAST OF GUAYMAS MEXICO. ...HIGH WINDS AND HEAVY RAINS EXPECTED IN PORTIONS OF NORTHWESTERN MEXICO... As of 11:00 AM MST Tue Sep 29 the center of Polo was located near 28.0, -110.6 with movement NE at 17 mph. The minimum central pressure was 984 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 75 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 29/1749Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL HOLDING STEADY SOUTH OF SOUTHWESTERN MEXICO. As of 12:00 PM CST Tue Sep 29 the center of Rachel was located near 15.7, -105.1 with movement NW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 987 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 65 mph.

data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Fay (AT1), advisory 29/2033Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY BECOMES A POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE. ...THIS IS THE LAST NHC ADVISORY ON THIS SYSTEM... As of 5:00 PM AST Tue Sep 29 the center of Fay was located near 23.7, -48.2 with movement WSW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1011 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 29/2034Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA STILL MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD WITH LITTLE CHANGE IN STRENGTH. As of 9:00 PM GMT Tue Sep 29 the center of Hanna was located near 34.0, -44.5 with movement SE at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.
